bug_semantics: Authenticated password-confirm page bbs/member_confirm.php takes GET url (via extract($_GET) and/or local assignment) and emits it as the HTML form action in member_confirm.skin.php. Host checks (parse_url, later check_url_host, and slash-backslash rewrites) do not treat a leading backslash as an external host, so member_confirm.php?url=\\google.com survives and the browser submits/navigates off-site (CWE-601). PoC in gnuboard/gnuboard5#319 requires a logged-in session because the page is members-only.
flaw_origin: The 2013 import 41d21074b5fcf579633c255f3b499434b2d4d46b first wrote both bbs/member_confirm.php and skin/member/basic/member_confirm.skin.php with form action="<?php echo $url ?>", while common.php @extract($_GET) already populated $url from the query string. Immediate parent 04c3efa279d60f646bf3b430750ab5a98fcc6eef is README-only. Later incomplete remediations added parse_url same-host checks (752ccd850, 2014) and check_url_host (458aecdf7, 2015) but still missed a lone leading backslash. Direct fix e03e01d41098f6a42788e53cb8bd5894ce47cd15 (2024-06-05, also labeled #318) calls safe_filter_url_host($url) in member_confirm.php and in shared goto_url/alert/confirm; first released in v5.5.17. CVE-2024-37658 remains published.

evidence: Advisory GHSA-239c-9qhp-4xc9 / CVE-2024-37658: open redirect in bbs/member_confirm.php on gnuboard5 5.5.16; NVD/GHSA published, withdrawn_at null. PoC from issue #319 (2024-05-31): member_confirm.php?url=\\google.com after login. First write 41d21074b5fcf579633c255f3b499434b2d4d46b added member_confirm.php plus skin form action="<?php echo $url ?>"; parent 04c3efa279d60f646bf3b430750ab5a98fcc6eef has neither file (git cat-file -e fails). BIC ancestor of v5.5.16. At v5.5.16 member_confirm.php calls check_url_host then preg_replace of leading /\\ and /// only — no backslash strip. Direct fix e03e01d41098f6a42788e53cb8bd5894ce47cd15 adds if (function_exists("safe_filter_url_host")) { $url = safe_filter_url_host($url); } in bbs/member_confirm.php and defines safe_filter_url_host in lib/common.lib.php; merge-base --is-ancestor e03e01d41 v5.5.16 fails, v5.5.17 succeeds. c6b58bb16 later removed a local $_GET url assignment but is not the first backslash filter. BIC commit object is human gnuboard <kagla@naver.com> with no AI trailers.
reasoning: Vulnerability is CWE-601 open redirect from using attacker-controlled url as the member_confirm form action. The smallest first-write of that sink is the 2013 import of the PHP page and skin, not the 2014/2015 host-check patches which still missed backslash. Parent-tree verification shows both files absent immediately before 41d21074b. The 2024 #318/#319 fix strips backslashes via safe_filter_url_host and lands in v5.5.17. AI judgment is BIC-only: 2013 human import, no AI markers. Therefore NOT_AI. Not FALSE_POSITIVE: CVE-2024-37658 remains published and the PoC matches v5.5.16.
